content: xml.attributeRef determines if the UML-attribute is serialized as a reference to a global XML at- 32 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 tribute. If set to true serializes the property as a reference to a global attribute. Applicable only if xml.attribute is set to true . The name of the referenced attribute is specified in xml.name . The namespace prefix of the referenced attribute is specified in xml.nsPrefix .
